summary: Ana harita dosyası tracked repo taramasıyla keşfedilir; yalnız 019 tarafından doğrulanmış gerçek runtime örneğiyle exact polygon popup kabul edilir.

gates.name: TRACKED_MAIN_MAP_BUNDLE_DISCOVERY
gates.detail: england_map_web tracked HTML plus local script dependencies are scored; ambiguity fails closed

gates.name: MAP_ENGINE_AND_POPUP_EVIDENCE
gates.detail: Leaflet or MapLibre evidence plus internet and exact identity tokens are required

gates.name: REAL_RUNTIME_SAMPLE_REQUIRED
gates.detail: runtime_results_latest.json must contain 30,761 validated real rows and one to eight real samples

gates.name: EXACT_FEATURE_IDENTITY
gates.detail: exact parcel_id or row_no; exactly one feature; nearest-feature and manual coordinate fallbacks forbidden

gates.name: POPUP_STATUS_AND_POSTCODE_CONTRACT
gates.detail: popup must preserve identity and current proxy postcode or explicit NO_DATA semantics

gates.name: PORT_8012_MAP_HTTP_AND_BROWSER
gates.detail: real canonical map page and browser execution required

gates.name: ZERO_BROWSER_ERRORS
gates.detail: zero console errors and page errors

gates.name: POLYGON_POPUP_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT
gates.detail: popup text SHA256 and exact sample identity receipt required
